title: feat(nm2sreadt2y): neighbor-read of 1-in 2-out split freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails, composition
science: opposite y-probes, unsigned neighbour-read, two cuts. Verdict identical at both cuts. Composition is forced: O(q,tau) is constant for all tau>=t(q)+1 (any step e in O(q) requires e in M(q+e), which forces t(q+e)=t(q)+1), so t+2 can never differ from t+1 and composition=HOLD carries zero information.
